slides.headline:
Grow light schedules
for kitchen herbs
slides.subhead: Simple on/off timing for countertop kits and clip lights — including studio sleep schedules.
slides.narration: Grow light schedules for kitchen herbs. The Sill Garden answer for a small apartment, without buying more equipment than you need.

slides.headline:
Match the setup
to your space.
slides.subhead: Light, noise, and spill risk matter more than pod count.
slides.narration: Start with usable space, daylight, and a tray that protects the rental surface. Then pick the smallest setup that still grows what you cook.

slides.headline:
Don't buy the
biggest kit first.
slides.subhead: Weak light is not a watering problem.
slides.narration: Skip the largest system until the plants prove they need it. Stretching stems usually mean more light, not more water.

slides.headline:
Start small.
Prove the routine.
slides.subhead: Run herbs about 14–16 hours on, 8–10 hours off. Align the dark period with your sleep if the garden shares your bedroom.
slides.narration: Our verdict: Run herbs about 14–16 hours on, 8–10 hours off. Align the dark period with your sleep if the garden shares your bedroom. Full guide on Sill Garden dot com.
